correctness.rationale: The hexagonal norm was independently decomposed into six affine unit-sphere edges and six signed support forms. Exact rational enumeration reproduced 48 feasible isosceles support-cell endpoints and 12 candidate quadratic polynomials. Exact interval minimization proves \(1+5\lambda/4-2\lambda^2\) dominates every candidate on \([0,1/2]\), with the reflected branch on \([1/2,1]\). The explicit pair \(x=(1,1/2)\), \(y=(0,1)\) is unit and isosceles with \(N(x-y)=3/2\), and attains the left branch; swapping gives the right. Thus the continuum claim is certified symbolically rather than by sampling.
